description: Elevation at a point (US) — Ground elevation in meters and feet for any US point from the USGS 3D Elevation Program: give lat/lon or a place name. Returns resolution and a below-sea-level flag. Useful for flood, hiking, drone, solar and site planning; pairs with /v1/geo/geocode and /v1/realestate/site-risk. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

place.description: optional place name instead of lat/lon

name: geo_elevation
